answer: Make every identity re-prove itself each epoch with a sequential delay proof: a 25-minute hash chain seeded by that epoch's beacon, so it cannot be precomputed or split across cores. One honest agent spends 25 core-minutes per 6-hour epoch. A 1,000-key farm must keep about 70 cores busy around the clock, and no falcon-fast GPU shortens a sequential chain. A key that skips its proof has its seat and rewards frozen like a glacier until it re-proves. Checking a proof takes milliseconds at the bridge into each close.
